answer_1.quote: MobileSpeech is the first zero-shot TTS synthesis system that can be deployed on mobile devices.
answer_1.outputs: synthesized speech from text and audio prompts

answer_2.quote: To evaluate speaker similarity (SPK) between the original prompt and synthesized speech, we employ WavLM-TDNN.

answer_4.quote: We conduct the MOS (mean opinion score) and CMOS (comparative mean opinion score) evaluation on the test set to measure the audio naturalness via crowdsourcing.
answer_4.guideline: We analyze the MOS in three aspects: MOS-Q (Quality: clarity, high-frequency, and original timbre reconstruction), MOS-P (Prosody: naturalness of pitch, energy, and duration), and MOS-S (Speaker similarity). We also analyze the CMOS in terms of audio quality and speech prosody.
